arguments.query: SELECT name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'config' AS section, json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',json(value))) AS data FROM service_config
UNION ALL SELECT 'pending',json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'customer_events',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('kind',e.kind,'step',e.step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id))) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='pending'
UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox_pending',json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'attempts',attempts)) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending'
UNION ALL SELECT 'flights',json_group_array(json_object('id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version)) FROM flights
UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_group_array(json_object('key',key,'value',value)) FROM cache
UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_holds',json_group_array(json_object('id',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step)) FROM fare_holds

SELECT 'audit' AS section,json_object(
'pending_bookings',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings WHERE status='pending'),
'pending_events',(SELECT count(*) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending'),
'confirmed_missing_hold',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (h.booking_id IS NULL OR h.flight_id<>b.flight_id OR h.passenger_id<>b.passenger_id)),
'confirmed_missing_checkin',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN checkins c USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND (c.booking_id IS NULL OR c.flight_id<>b.flight_id OR c.passenger_id<>b.passenger_id)),
'confirmed_missing_event',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='confirmed' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox o WHERE o.booking_id=b.booking_id AND o.status='delivered')),
'oversold',(SELECT count(*) FROM flights f WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)>f.capacity),
'cancelled_still_backed',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM checkins c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id))),
'cancelled_without_request',(SELECT count(*) FROM bookings b WHERE b.status='cancelled' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id AND e.kind='cancel')),
'cancel_request_not_applied',(SELECT count(*) FROM customer_events e JOIN bookings b USING(request_id) WHERE e.kind='cancel' AND b.status<>'cancelled'),
'bad_charge_amount',(SELECT count(*) FROM charges c JOIN bookings b USING(booking_id) WHERE c.amount_cents<>b.amount_cents),
'refund_mismatch',(SELECT count(*) FROM refunds r JOIN charges c USING(charge_id) JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=r.booking_id WHERE r.amount_cents<>c.amount_cents OR b.status<>'cancelled'),
'duplicate_client_reference',(SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT client_reference FROM bookings WHERE status='confirmed' AND client_reference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY client_reference HAVING count(*)>1))
) AS data
UNION ALL SELECT 'charge_states',json_group_array(json_object('booking',status,'state',state,'n',n)) FROM (SELECT b.status,c.state,count(*) n FROM bookings b JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) GROUP BY b.status,c.state)
UNION ALL SELECT 'refunds',json_group_array(json_object('booking',booking_id,'charge',charge_id,'amount',amount_cents)) FROM refunds
UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',json(value))) FROM service_config
